main_topics.reason: The user described the same deep, cyclical pelvic ache returning three months after surgery and asked whether that timing was normal.
The user opened by asking whether another operation was needed and later asked when repeat surgery would be considered.
The user asked specifically about the hormonal IUD and discussed alternatives to the pill as possible next steps.
The user explained that the combined pill caused low mood and loss of libido, which shaped what treatments they were willing to consider.
The user engaged with the explanation that pelvic floor muscles or pain sensitization could also contribute to the pain.
The user welcomed the suggestion to request the operative note and accepted a plan to discuss options with their surgeon or gynecologist.
The user said they felt defeated after expecting surgery to fix the pain, then later expressed feeling more hopeful.

output.summary: The user described cyclical pelvic pain returning three months after endometriosis surgery and wanted to know whether another operation was needed. The assistant discussed non-surgical options, possible contributors to pain, and requesting the operative note; the user said the plan was clear and felt less worried that surgery was the only path.
